description:
Objective: remove contradictory batch instructions and define the minimum shared contract consumed by the runtime and BenchBox. This task owns only joeharris76/skill-sync-skills and ends at its reviewed merged PR; it does not activate the new consumer behavior.

Prior art: extend skills/todo/references/batch.md and the affected shared change/review/code workflow sources discovered from the catalog. Preserve the existing leader/member split and ordinary dependency semantics. Supersede separate member-result-cache replay and cache-authoritative acceptance; repository policy, not generic skill prose, chooses serial versus cohesive-batch delivery. Do not embed BenchBox make targets into generic skills.

Implementation: describe member execution of mapped UNION named checks on a clean captured base/head; member local review; leader acceptance through the trusted launcher for the exact patch with executable/policy refs pinned together; retained structured result in prepared verification.review; retained early overlap/fix reruns derived from receipts on each attempt; fresh execution of EVERY member's recorded acceptance plus combined checks on final HEAD. Preserve exempt-only not-reviewed/adjudication semantics without claiming fresh-model review. Describe authoritative pre-arm discovery, snapshot-pinned authoritative pages, ordinary-PR skip of full batch evidence (not discovery), and fail-closed outage/ambiguity behavior. Document guarded recovery relocation as an explicit additive capability, not an automatic path rewrite. Generic capability name: todo_db_batch.features.integration_worktree_relocation=true; relocation tuple uses expected_integration_worktree, expected_integration_head and integration_worktree, all-or-nothing.

Decision gates: first reconcile the approved decisions with current shared and repository contracts. New instruction text describes the required feature contract and does not claim a pinned consumer/runtime already implements it. A new capability must be advertised by the installed runtime before invoking relocation; no package-version-string substitute. Shared behavioral rules stay in their existing owner files rather than being copied into every wrapper.

Guardrails: one catalog PR; no rollout task or observation period; no tracked mirror edits in consuming repositories. Required member checks/review remain before landing, combined review remains before publication, hosted gates remain exact-head, final PR must actually merge before finish, and leader worktree/local branch cleanup is last after member cleanup and fresh merged-PR proof. Preserve recovery credentials and finding/dispute history; label ledger operational hints/credential material rather than acceptance authority.
